title: Mihulish commands and ticket system
summary: Added video search, wiki lookup, moderation commands, a ticket system, and configurable ticket reminder pings to @mihulish.
description: @mihulish got a big upgrade with video search, wiki lookup, moderation tools, a ticket system, and a ticket reminder ping toggle.

body.text: Added video search to @mihulish. Use /vd link:<link> — it's just like /dn but with a video link for anyone who can't find the dn.
Added wiki lookup to @mihulish. Use /wiki article:<keyword> to search the wiki by article name.
Added a set of moderation commands:

items: /snipe — detects all deleted messages from the last 6 hours in a channel
/purge count:<number> — deletes up to 100 messages from the channel
/addrole user:<user> role:<role> / /removerole user:<user> role:<role> — adds or removes a role from a person
/learn — pulls information from chat transcripts to help update wiki pages

body.text: Added a ticket system to @mihulish. The panel options and form are still being debugged.
Managers can now choose whether tickets need a 24h ping cycle. By default, it pings the ticket creator and the staff member who last sent a message.
